extracted.name: Chicken Fried Deer Steak
ingredient_lines: 2 lbs venison (back straps if you’ve got em’)
Cajun seasoning of season all (to taste)
instruction_lines: Trim, cut, and tenderize venison. I run mine through and meat tenderizer/cuber. You can do it with a meat tenderizer mallet.
Mix together flour and seasonings. You can season your flour however you’d like. I listed that seasonings I add to mine.
Remove venison from buttermilk and coat in flour mixture one at a time. Lay them out on a baking sheet. Put them back in the refrigerator for 15-20 minutes to let the batter set.
Heat oil in a heavy skillet for frying. Once hot, add steaks to oil working in batches of 2-3 at a time. Cook on each side till golden brown. Set aside on paper towel to absorb the oil.
Serve with country gravy and enjoy!
